topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I climb the ladder into the attic, the old wooden steps creaking under my weight. The air up here is thick and musty, a stark contrast to the tidy, familiar rest of the house. As I shine my flashlight around, the beam catches on a stack of boxes I hadn't noticed before. I approach slowly, the floorboards groaning with each step. The contents are a puzzle — old photographs, yellowed newspapers, and a peculiar collection of trinkets. My hands tremble slightly as I thumb through the pages of a diary, the ink faded butstill legible. I can't shake the sense that I'm intruding on someone else's life, a chapter of the home's story I wasn’t meant to read.
